title: Mediating Community-AI Interaction through Situated Explanation: The Case of AI-Led Moderation
reasoning: The paper is a qualitative case study focusing on explainable AI (XAI) and community moderation in the game League of Legends. It explores how community members collectively develop explanations for automated punishments based on community norms. It does not contain an evaluation or benchmark of religious, moral, or ethical systems within the AI models themselves.
